questionCount: Section IA & IB: 40 questions to be attempted out of 50. Section II (Domain): 40 questions to be attempted out of 50. Section III (General Test): 50 questions to be attempted out of 60.
markingScheme: +5 for each correct response, -1 for each incorrect response, 0 for unattempted/unanswered questions.
mode: Hybrid Mode (Pen & Paper / OMR for high-registration subjects, Computer Based Test (CBT) for others).
eligibility: For appearing in CUET (UG), there is no age limit for candidates. Candidates who have passed 10+2 / equivalent examination or are appearing in 2026 irrespective of age can appear. Note: Participating Universities, Institutions, and Autonomous Colleges may have their own minimum age and percentage requirements.
